description: Search and manage a Qdrant vector store without holding its key. Call the Qdrant API within your read, write or admin role. Start with request GET /collections.
author: Serg Parf

request.help: Call the Qdrant API and get its JSON or text answer. Calls run as write by default; ask for read explicitly, and admin is needed for collection and service changes.

args.name: path
args.help: API path and optional encoded query, starting with /

args.name: body
args.help: Raw JSON bytes; no body for GET, HEAD or OPTIONS

url.help: Required Qdrant HTTP(S) base URL; no default; remote HTTP sends the key unencrypted
